scope: Actual pinned dense and leaf maple node slot iteration

verification.regression: Before the fix the four-byte case returned only the first of three expected nonzero slots; after the fix four/eight-byte cases match actual pinned outputs including a hole between populated slots.

limitations: The actual pinned method receives mocked typed nodes and context. This establishes dense and leaf slot iteration only, not full reference object validation or real-image VMA extraction.

Native dense nodes prefer alloc.slot when present, matching the pinned method and the local Kali ISF layout, with a flat slot fallback for older layouts. Four/eight-byte tests include conflicting flat slot data; this is layout evidence, not a real dense-node image capture.
Leaf nodes scan every slot and skip low-nibble-only metadata markers, matching pinned filtering. Internal-node pivot/meta termination and stricter native validation remain separate parity gaps.
Real Linux32 end-to-end acceptance is not established and the public Linux32 ISF parse gate remains closed.
No full plugin contract is established.
